target_beneficiary: Landholding farmer families (husband, wife, and minor children) owning cultivable agricultural land
benefit_details: Direct income support of Rs 6,000 per financial year disbursed via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts in three equal installments of Rs 2,000 across 4-month cycles (April-July, August-November, December-March).
eligibility_criteria: Ownership of cultivable agricultural land registered in the state database. Excludes institutional landholders, government employees, constitutional post holders, income tax payers, and high-income professionals.
how_to_apply: Register online at pmkisan.gov.in under New Farmer Registration or visit nearest Common Service Centre (CSC). Mandatory prerequisites include completing eKYC (OTP or Face Authentication) and mandatory Farmer ID registration under the central AgriStack framework.
documents_required: Aadhaar card, Aadhaar-seeded bank account linked to NPCI mapper, land ownership records (Khata/Khasra), and unique Farmer ID.
contact_details: Portal: pmkisan.gov.in. PM-KISAN Helpline: 155261, 1800-115-526. Status check online under Beneficiary Status.

target_beneficiary: Small and marginal farmers owning up to 2 hectares of cultivable land
benefit_details: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of Rs 3,000 after attaining 60 years of age on a 50:50 voluntary contributory model (farmer pays Rs 55 to Rs 200 per month matched rupee-for-rupee by Central Government). LIC manages the fund. 50% family pension (Rs 1,500/month) for spouse upon subscriber demise.
eligibility_criteria: Small and marginal farmers aged 18 to 40 years at entry. Must not be enrolled in other statutory social security schemes (NPS, EPFO, PM-SYM). Income tax payers excluded.
how_to_apply: Enroll at nearest CSC or self-register on maandhan.in. Initial premium paid in cash with subsequent auto-debit linked to bank account or PM-KISAN installment.
documents_required: Aadhaar card, savings bank account passbook or cancelled cheque, and active mobile number.
contact_details: Portal: maandhan.in. LIC Helpline: 1800-267-6888. PM-KMY Toll Free: 1800-3000-3468.

benefit_details: Short-term institutional credit for crop cultivation and working capital at 4% effective interest rate (7% base rate minus 2% interest subvention minus 3% Prompt Repayment Incentive). Collateral-free borrowing up to Rs 2 lakh (RBI limit). Card validity 5 years.
eligibility_criteria: Active farmers with cultivable land or individuals engaged in dairy, poultry, piggery, or fisheries. No minimum landholding barrier.

documents_required: Application form, passport photos, identity proof (Aadhaar/Voter ID), address proof, land parcel records/cropping pattern records.

benefit_details: Comprehensive yield insurance covering localized natural calamities, post-harvest losses, pests, wild-animal attacks, and inundation. Premium capped at 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, and 5% for commercial/horticultural crops. Government pays remaining premium.
eligibility_criteria: Farmers growing notified crops in notified regions, aged 18 to 70 years. Claims for localized losses must be registered within 72 hours of the event.

benefit_details: Zero-balance basic savings bank account with no account maintenance fees. Includes complimentary RuPay debit card with integrated Rs 2 lakh accidental death insurance cover. Overdraft facility up to Rs 10,000 for accounts operated satisfactorily for 6 months (priority to women).

benefit_details: Free provision of legally validated Property Card (Record of Rights) generated using high-resolution drone mapping and GIS survey technology by Survey of India. Enables using rural residential assets as financial collateral for bank loans and resolves property boundary disputes.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan (PM-KUSUM)
target_beneficiary: Individual farmers, water user associations, cooperatives, and farmer clusters
benefit_details: Capital subsidy for standalone solar agricultural pumps (3 HP to 10 HP under Component B) and solarization of grid-tied agricultural pumps (Component C). Central financial assistance provides 30% subsidy, with state top-ups bringing cumulative subsidy to 60% to 90%. Sale of surplus solar power to DISCOMs for 25 years under Component A.
eligibility_criteria: Ownership of cultivable land with operational water source. Standalone pump applicant must not have active grid electricity connection on field.
how_to_apply: Apply via State Nodal Renewable Energy Agency portal (e.g., MEDA, RRECL) or regional DISCOM portal. National overview at pmkusum.mnre.gov.in.
documents_required: Aadhaar card, land records (Khasra/Khatauni), bank account details, proof of water source.
contact_details: Portal: pmkusum.mnre.gov.in. MNRE Helpline: 1800-180-3333.

target_beneficiary: Small, marginal, and traditional farmers in 100 low-performing agricultural districts across India
benefit_details: Macro-convergence initiative spanning 6 years (2025-2031) with total outlay of Rs 1.44 lakh crore (Rs 24,000 crore annually) overhauling districts with low crop yields and below-average credit. Consolidates 36 agricultural schemes across 11 ministries to boost yields by 20-30%, expand solar irrigation, optimize credit distribution, and establish block-level post-harvest storage.
eligibility_criteria: Farmers cultivating land holdings (< 2 hectares) within 100 targeted districts identified by NITI Aayog monitoring dashboard.
how_to_apply: Saturation-based governance model where district development plans are executed directly by District Collectors and Agricultural Universities. Benefits delivered at block/panchayat level.
documents_required: Aadhaar card, land parcel records, unique Farmer ID, banking details.
contact_details: Portal: pmddky.niti.gov.in. NITI Aayog and Ministry of Agriculture.

benefit_details: Capital procurement subsidy for agricultural machinery (tractors, power tillers, rotavators, laser land levelers, drones). 40% to 50% subsidy for General category; 50% to 80% subsidy for small, marginal, SC/ST, and women farmers. 40% to 80% financial grants for establishing Custom Hiring Centres (CHCs).

target_beneficiary: Farmers, farming cooperatives, and registered Water User Associations
benefit_details: Financial subsidy for micro-irrigation systems (drip and sprinkler networks). 55% subsidy for small and marginal farmers, 45% for general category farmers. Funding shared 60:40 between Centre and States (90:10 for Himalayan/NE states).

how_to_apply: Apply online at pmksy.gov.in, state horticulture portals, or offline through Block Agriculture Officer or Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK).
documents_required: Aadhaar card, bank passbook, verified land mutation records, passport photo, SC/ST certificate (if applicable).

scheme_name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)
target_beneficiary: Adult members of rural households seeking livelihood security through unskilled manual work
benefit_details: Statutory legal guarantee of at least 100 days of unskilled manual wage employment per fiscal year per household. Wages disbursed via DBT within 15 days of muster roll closure. eligibility_criteria: Adult Indian nationals residing permanently within local Gram Panchayat jurisdiction. Both APL and BPL households eligible.
how_to_apply: Apply for permanent Job Card at local Gram Panchayat or via nrega.nic.in, then submit written demand for work to Panchayat Secretary.
documents_required: Aadhaar card, Ration card, passport photo, Aadhaar-linked savings bank account passbook.
contact_details: Portal: nrega.nic.in. Helpline: 1800-180-6606. Local Gram Panchayat.
